messages:
tara: Need final GA acceptance for 'Predictor v2' covering SLA, support, docs, monitoring, and pricing appendix. Can we align here before EOD?
josh: Proposed SLOs: Hosted uptime 99.95; p99 gen <= 275ms (seq <512). Dedicated: uptime 99.9; throughput SLAs contract-bound.
mina: Monitoring must include p50/p90/p99, errors, tokens/min, model-specific tail. Add direct links in runbook to dashboard tiles. I can build tiles if SLO numbers land.
sre-bot: Canary rule: 10m steady with p95 < 220ms and error rate <0.2%. Rollback if p99 spikes >50% for 5m. Include healthcheck curl example.
claire-sales: Sales language: public blurb with tiers (Free/Standard/Premium). Standard = production-ready email support, Premium = 1h triage + phone. Put technical SLOs in an appendix link.
tara: Pricing: need FinOps sims for 100 qps and 1M tokens/mo to set premium margin. Josh, can you provide quota table draft?
josh: Draft quota mapping: free=20rps, standard=60rps (burst 300), premium=200rps sustained. Soft-throttle at 1.2x, hard-reject at 1.5x with error code and billing hint.
mina: Runbook checklist items: SLA doc, incident severity matrix, canary steps, rollback playbook, health-check snippet, dashboard links, customer troubleshooting FAQ. I'll own runbook draft.
tara: Owners: Tara -> public SLA + legal review; Josh -> SLO YAML + quota table; Mina -> runbook + dashboards; Claire -> sales blurb + appendix draft. Deadline: Fri COB. Quick sync 09:30 tomorrow for 10m.
sre-bot: Reminder: include automated alerts and runbook links in the rollout PR.
tara: Thanks all. Closing thread and will ping when drafts are in PR.
